name: Workspace Superpowers
description: Portable workflows for documents, research, citations, spreadsheets, presentations, and verified deliverables. Local dogfooding build.
safetyNotes: Native prompt bootstrap plus a session-scoped checklist tool and host-loaded panel. agent.tool.register registers workspace_checklist; ui.panel renders it and returns revision-checked lifecycle actions. session.read reads the executing session's retained tool receipts for conservative recovery. Checklist state lives in the plugin process; no separate database, file writes, credentials or network requests are used. Tool and panel state never authorize document drafting or clear missing evidence.
